question.problem:
Find the characteristic equation of the matrix 
$B=[\begin{aligned}-1 & -8 & -4 \\ 3 & 8 & 3 \\ -6 & -10 & -3\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
First, we find the matrix $\,B-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
B-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}-1-\lambda  & -8 & -4 \\ 3 & 8-\lambda  & 3 \\ -6 & -10 & -3-\lambda \end{aligned}]
$$

The characteristic equation is $det(B-\lambda I)=0.$ 

Expanding the determinant across the $1$st row, we get the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(B-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}-1-\lambda  & -8 & -4 \\ 3 & 8-\lambda  & 3 \\ -6 & -10 & -3-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (-1-\lambda )|\begin{aligned}8-\lambda  & 3 \\ -10 & -3-\lambda \end{aligned}|-(-8)|\begin{aligned}3 & 3 \\ -6 & -3-\lambda \end{aligned}|+(-4)|\begin{aligned}3 & 8-\lambda  \\ -6 & -10\end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (-1-\lambda )({\lambda }^{2}-5\lambda +6)+8(-3\lambda +9)-4(-6\lambda +18) & =0 \\ (-{\lambda }^{3}+4{\lambda }^{2}-\lambda -6)+(-24\lambda +72)-(-24\lambda +72) & =0 \\ -{\lambda }^{3}+4{\lambda }^{2}-\lambda -6 & =0 \\ {\lambda }^{3}-4{\lambda }^{2}+\lambda +6 & =0\end{aligned}
$$
